integrity: The source curvature expression is evaluated exactly on a quadratic, yielding a closed scalar recursion. The reset-count bound follows from disjoint multiplicative-expansion blocks, and the terminal-rate interval is both proved and realized by an explicit positive summable expansion tail.
scientific_limitations: The exact recurrence and rate window are proved for the unconstrained scalar quadratic specialization. Multidimensional curvature coupling is not classified. The sharp fast-rate window requires at least one reset; no-reset trajectories can remain arbitrarily conservative.
title: Exact reset budget and terminal-rate window of MPG-NGD on scalar quadratics
